scope: One existing Chinese save-selection screen on the prior batch; not a runtime test of the new batch or a high-resolution font replacement.

emulator.name: DuckStation
emulator.configuration: Portable application and settings under local/; independent fixture copy; no system-wide installation.

observed_result: At the same window output size, 4x is visibly sharper around Chinese characters; it still displays the source bitmap's pixelated or crowded strokes.
texture_replacement: not_tested; compatibility with this game's dynamic glyph uploads is unknown

crash.context: The application exited abnormally once while opening/changing the graphics settings; the cause was not established.
crash.restart: The isolated application was restarted with the 4x configuration and successfully produced the comparison screenshot.

limits: Only the named game screen, emulator build, BIOS and settings were compared.
Both captures are screen-sized exports and the animated scene may not be at the same frame.
No redesigned font, texture replacement, retail BIOS, other emulator or hardware was tested.
Screenshots, game assets and the independent memory card remain local.
